scope: Composition of retained native C-Bus 3 Save-to-NVM semantics with the evidenced one-through-six-bridge PTP/Reply Network envelope; scripted cmqttd acceptance only, with no live bridge or power-cycle persistence claim

retained_native_evidence.finding: Literal native C-Gate requests use group 0 operation 4 EXECUTE followed by POLL.
Native extended replies carry the correlated group, operation and status; NAK is definitive.
Original receiver correlation admits Reply Network paths through one to six bridges and rejects route, unit and CAL mismatches.

cmqttd_acceptance: Transport tests pin the exact one-hop and six-hop EXECUTE/POLL request bytes.
Direct, neighbouring-route, wrong-unit, wrong-group and wrong-operation replies cannot complete the transaction.
Every exchange is sent once; a lost or incomplete result faults the programming lane until reconnect and is never replayed.
The service test performs a verified routed standard-CAL STORE and readback before the C-Bus 3 EXECUTE/POLL sequence, then commits only the owned programming session on the captured PCI generation.
The real-daemon fake-PCI/MQTT test exercises the same routed save path while the shared connection remains active.
evidence_boundaries: No physical bridge or routed C-Bus 3 unit completed this sequence in the acceptance run.
A successful status proves the retained command exchange, not NVM durability or power-cycle survival.

This NVM fixture exercises the routed direct-method STORE/readback before EXECUTE/POLL; native_cgate_routed_pp_methods.json separately covers direct, page-aware, NCC, OEM and GOC-family transfer methods, while live hardware and power-cycle durability remain unverified.
Multi-range recovery after an earlier confirmed STORE and later failure remains an operator workflow boundary.
